contract.intent: Planner kernel + Flow config + Provider adapter (S5) — orchestrates node lifecycle per flow-control-spec v4 (spawn to materialize to GATE1 to validate to activate to execute to verify to GATE2 to commit to look-back); frontmost-ready selection; bounded rework + chain append; owns spec expansion (F9); consumes per-project flow config (data, not code — AC-3); uniform LLM interface with multiple providers + per-task model selection (F17).
acceptanceCriteria: Lifecycle orchestration per flow-control-spec v4; every human decision at a task gate
Frontmost-ready selection: prefix order, failed/superseded siblings skipped
Bounded rework: 3 rejections per gate then escalate; no unbounded loops
Flow config: reads/validates project step chains (data, not code); step-chain templates (F3); code never overrides project config
Provider adapter: multiple providers + per-task model selection (F17); retries + rate-limit handling; fail-closed structured error on failure
Spec expansion (F9): detailed specs from the vision artifact
